fields.subject: Connection Configuration Hierarchy
fields.condition: a credential property — UserName, Password, or WindowsAuth — is assigned a value different from the one it currently holds
fields.response: raise the PropertyChanged event, naming the changed property as the event's property name
fields.postcondition: a Data connection holding this configuration level recomputes its resolved connection settings rather than reusing the ones resolved before the change. The resilience settings (RetryCount, RetryInterval, RetryLengthening, CircuitBreakerFailureCount, CircuitBreakerTestInterval) raise no PropertyChanged; a change to them reaches the connection's resilience policy on its next execution instead.

sources.label: resilience settings, which raise no PropertyChanged
resilience setting changes are picked up on the next execution
Postgres connection subscribes to its own PropertyChanged; the handler clears the cached connection string and description
Postgres connection subscribes to the ambient (global, shard-set, read/write, shard) layers' PropertyChanged and clears its caches when the chain is set
Postgres connection string is rebuilt when the cache is empty
